systems.owner: State of Senegal; financing discussed with the African Development Bank and BOAD, with a concession under discussion
systems.tiers: A national project for data hosting, digital sovereignty and the digital economy, about 95 per cent built on 20 May 2026 and held up by financial and contractual blockages; no local government office is said to use it

note: The Council of Ministers communiqué of 20 May 2026: the President asked for an emergency plan on civil registration by end June 2026 and faster full digitalisation of it, naming no system and no connection of civil registration centres or communes; collectivités territoriales otherwise appear on markets and the evaluation of mayors.
